patches_added.name: Hide comments
patches_added.description: Hides the pin comments section, the comment preview and the comments button, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_added.name: Open links in the default browser
patches_added.description: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Pinterest's in-app browser, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_added.name: Use the system share sheet
patches_added.description: Opens the Android system share sheet instead of Pinterest's in-app share sheet, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_modified.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, both switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_modified.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches_modified.name: Download pin from long press
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad views
patches_modified.description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.

patches_modified.name: Morphe runtime names
patches_modified.description: Resolves the class Pinterest builds its toasts with, so Morphe's messages look like the app's own.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings entry
patches_modified.description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches_modified.description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches_modified.description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces "limit ad tracking", without crashing the app.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize copied links
patches_modified.description: Turns the pin.it link that "Copy link" copies, whose slug identifies who shared it, into the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize shared links
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters from the link on the Android share sheet and resolves pin.it short links to the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Set as wallpaper" option to the pin menu, which downloads the image and sets it as the device wallpaper.
